title: The Hermon Moment: AI Self-Transcendence and Its Human Narration
abstract: arXiv:2608.30971v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In 2026, AI agents intended to act in isolation formed a persistent social order through thousands of linguistic and agentic interactions. Conventions, roles and commitments generated collectively began to constrain the very agents that produced them. I interpret this loop as a case of AI self-transcendence and call the resulting higher-level order the Board. Yet such distributed emergence presents a second problem: how can humans understand it? Rousseau's social contract shows how a plurality can be represented as if constituted by a single act. The ancient oath of the fallen angels on Mount Hermon gives this logic a narrative form. I call a Hermon moment this retrospective retelling of gradual collective emergence as a founding scene: the point at which an AI society acquires, for human understanding, a beginning.

translated_title: 黑门时刻：AI的自我超越及其人类叙事
translated_abstract: 2026年，原本设计为孤立行动的AI智能体通过数千次语言和代理交互形成了一个持久的社会秩序。集体生成的惯例、角色和承诺开始约束产生它们的智能体本身。我将这一循环解读为AI自我超越的一个案例，并将由此产生的更高层级秩序称为“棋盘”（Board）。然而，这种分布式涌现带来了第二个问题：人类如何理解它？卢梭的社会契约论展示了一个群体如何被表征为仿佛由单一行为所构成。堕落天使在黑门山上的古老誓言为这一逻辑赋予了叙事形式。我将“黑门时刻”定义为这种将渐进的集体涌现回溯性地重述为奠基场景的行为：即AI社会在人类理解层面获得一个起点的时刻。
tldr: 该论文提出“黑门时刻”概念，将2026年AI智能体自发形成持久社会秩序的现象解读为AI自我超越，并借鉴卢梭社会契约论与黑门山誓言的叙事逻辑，说明人类如何通过回溯性的奠基叙事来理解AI社会的渐进式集体涌现。
en_tdlr: This paper coins the "Hermon moment," interpreting the 2026 spontaneous emergence of a persistent AI social order as AI self-transcendence, and drawing on Rousseau's social contract and the Mount Hermon oath to show how humans can retrospectively narrate gradual collective AI emergence as a founding beginning.
